source: scripts/gnani_smoke_test.py runs on 2026-11-08 with the project key (see docs/smoke_test_result.json). A language is exposed in the UI only when both STT and TTS are 'verified'.
stt_endpoint: POST https://api.vachana.ai/stt/v3 (multipart audio_file + language_code), Prisma v2.5 default model
tts_endpoint: POST https://api.vachana.ai/api/v1/tts/inference (JSON), model timbre-v2.5, WAV 16 kHz mono 16-bit

code_mixed.note: Docs list no en-hi-IN-latn code. Prisma v3.0 offers format=codemix; Timbre offers language hi-en. Not yet tested with this key.
